source: Ghia, U., Ghia, K.N. and Shin, C.T. (1982), 'High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method', Journal of Computational Physics 48:387-411.
note: Table I is u along the vertical centreline (x = 0.5), Table II is v along the horizontal centreline (y = 0.5). Both are non-dimensionalised by the lid speed, and the ordinate runs from the stationary wall (0) to the lid (1). The 17 ordinates are the same in both tables as in the Re = 1000 file beside this one, which is the cheapest check that this column was read off the right rows. READ THIS CAVEAT BEFORE QUOTING TABLE II: the u column was read from the scanned paper and independently from a public transcription and the two agree on all 17 values; the v column was read from the scan alone, because no second transcription of Table II could be found, so it rests on one OCR of a 1982 scan. The scan's own heading for Table II reads 'u-Velocity along Horizontal Line', which is either a typo in the paper or an artefact of the OCR -- the paper's text and figure 2 make it unambiguous that the quantity is v.
